info.title: Production REST API
info.description:
A task manager's API: workspaces that people share with roles, projects in a
workspace, and tasks in a project.

**Logging in.** `POST /auth/register` or `POST /auth/login` answers with an
`accessToken` and a `refreshToken`. Send the access token on every other
request, as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. It's short-lived: when it
expires, trade the refresh token for new ones at `POST /auth/refresh`.

**Errors.** Every error has the same shape:
`{ "error": { "code": "EMAIL_TAKEN", "message": "..." } }`. Programs switch on
`code` (the `Error` schema lists them all); `message` is for people and its
wording may change.

**Request ids.** Every answer has an `x-request-id` header. Quote it when you
report a problem: it finds that request's log lines.

bearerAuth.description: The accessToken from POST /auth/login or POST /auth/register

code.description: What went wrong, for programs: switch on this

message.description: What went wrong, for people: the wording may change

details.description: Only for VALIDATION_ERROR: one entry per problem

path.description: Where the problem is, as a JSON Pointer: "/email", or "/" for the whole input

Error.description: The body of every error answer

User.description: A user (never with their password hash)

refreshToken.description: Trade it for new tokens at POST /auth/refresh, once

expiresIn.description: How long the access token lasts, such as "15m"

AuthResponse.description: A user, and the tokens of their new session
